cached_motivation_analysis.interpretation: 0 of 15 cached patents have 3+ motivation keywords. These patents teach SOME of the combination elements but no single patent teaches ALL elements (L3-L7).

103_conclusion.motivation_to_combine: PARTIALLY EXISTS — multiple patents teach retention, drainage, and exposure concepts individually. But NO patent teaches combining them in an endovascular CSF-to-venous shunt context.
103_conclusion.reasonable_expectation: UNCERTAIN — a PHOSITA seeing the individual elements might attempt the combination, but the 327% magnitude is unexpected (shunt length is short relative to drug distribution distance).
103_conclusion.teaching_away: PARTIAL — rapid CSF turnover (~7h) may teach away from attempting drug residence in shunt.
103_conclusion.unexpected_result: YES — 327% improvement (median 638% across 100 parameter combinations) is much larger than PHOSITA would predict from 80mm shunt with 1.4 mL/min drainage.
103_conclusion.conclusion: 103 leans NON_OBVIOUS: individual elements are known, but (1) no motivation to combine in eShunt context, (2) unexpected magnitude, (3) teaching away from rapid CSF turnover. Patent counsel opinion required.
103_conclusion.status: HYPOTHESIS — leans NON_OBVIOUS but not a legal conclusion
103_conclusion.critical_rule: Do NOT use 327% retrospectively as the reason someone would have combined them. The question is what a PHOSITA would have expected BEFORE the invention.
